item.content:encoded:
Highly Tailored IT Design, Management & Support Services

Kreatazz is an innovative IT services startup with presence in Pune and Hyderabad. Our team consists of experienced professionals who are passionate about technology and dedicated to delivering exceptional service.

We understand the unique challenges businesses face and strive to provide tailored solutions that meet those challenges head-on. Our knowledge and industry insights position us as a trusted partner in delivering cutting-edge technology solutions and exceptional talent to our clients

Our vision

To be the leading force in driving digital transformation, empowering businesses across industries with innovative technology solutions and exceptional talent.

Our Mission

Our mission is to harness our deep industry insights and passion for technology to deliver exceptional and tailored solutions to businesses

Why Choose Us?

  • Expertise: Our team comprises seasoned professionals with deep industry knowledge and technical expertise.
  • Innovation: We stay ahead of the curve by leveraging the latest technologies and trends.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Your success is our priority. We work closely with you to understand your needs and deliver solutions that exceed expectations.
  • Reliability: With a proven track record of successful projects, we are a partner you can trust.
  • Commitment to Quality: We adhere to the highest standards of quality and excellence in everything we do.

Join Us on Our Journey

At Kreatazz Tech, we are more than just a technology company – we are your partner in progress. Whether you’re a startup looking to scale or an established enterprise seeking to innovate, we are here to help you achieve your goals. Let’s build the future together.

Explore our services, meet our team, and discover how Kreatazz Tech can help your business reach new heights. Contact us today to get started!

item.content:encoded:
Human Resources Services

Human resources is the fuel that runs any organization. Finding the right person for the right job requires time, effort, and precision. KITS can be your trusted partner for all staffing requirements, such as Headhunting, Outsourcing & Payroll Service Management.

Permanent Recruitment

Over the years, we have developed a deep understanding of industries and their operational dynamics, not just locally but also globally. With such expertise, we have enjoyed the privilege of being the obvious choice as recruitment partners for organizations seeking excellence and agility. Matching the aspirations of candidates with that of the organizations after vision and culture is Humanly Possible.

Contract Staffing

We are known for providing the best in class service staffing solutions that meet an organization's flexibility needs to seasonality and deliver on opportunistic initiatives. From candidate attraction to performance management of the contingent workforce, we take accountability and responsibility for our workforce. We comply to provide efficient and effective management of workforce through payrolling.

Executive Search Process

At KITS, we invest in understanding the context of the client, the organization’s structure, the role to be filled, and its context. This understanding is captured in a document and forms the basis of the next few steps in the search process, followed by the premier staffing companies in India.

Based on the brief prepared earlier in the process, we create a plan to identify the possible matches. We review this plan with the client and co-create it. Then, we plan the communication with the potential candidates. We get into the next step, talent attraction, followed by talent assessment. We present our assessment of the short-listed candidates to the client and discuss further to draw up meeting schedules. With debriefs and reference checks happening simultaneously, we arrive at the selects. Offers are worked out in collaboration with the client. Throughout the process, we anchor the relationship with the candidates and help them set the ‘right expectations’ about the process, the role, the support systems, and the offer. With our 30-60-90 days’ touch-base plan, the whole process typically takes 8-12 weeks.

Scope of Work

  • Understanding the organization, the structure, the context of each role holder and the requirements.
  • Designing a plan for talent attraction, candidate assessment, and candidate communication.
  • Advertising the jobs on a variety of media.
  • Sourcing candidates through multiple channels: interest check and validate suitability.
  • Managing vendors and internal referrals, if any.
  • Receiving and screening applications sourced through all the channels – KITS internal database, external sources, and referrals.
  • Capturing details of the applicants in a format that is trackable over a period of time.
  • Coordinating interviews and any other steps in the selection process with shortlisted candidates.
  • Working with client teams for the issuance of offer letters to successful candidates.
  • Negotiating offers with the candidates.
  • Engaging offered candidates till their successful joining.

Mobile/Web Application Development Services

Mobile/Web Application Development services for ramping up your organizations digital maturity

Mobile Application Development

  • Native Mobile App Development: Building custom mobile applications for iOS and Android using native technologies.
  • Cross-Platform Mobile Development: Developing apps that work across iOS and Android using frameworks like React Native or Flutter.
  • Mobile App UI/UX Design: Crafting user-friendly interfaces and seamless user experiences.

Web Application Development

  • Custom Web App Development: Tailored web applications built to meet unique business requirements.
  • Progressive Web Apps (PWA): Building fast, reliable, and engaging web apps with offline capabilities.
  • E-commerce Web Development: Creating secure, scalable, and user-friendly e-commerce platforms.

App Testing and QA Services

  • Mobile and Web App Testing: Comprehensive testing of mobile and web applications for performance, usability, and security.
  • Automated Testing: Implementing automated testing for consistent quality assurance.
  • Usability Testing: Ensuring that the mobile or web application is user-friendly and intuitive.

App Maintenance and Support

  • Ongoing App Maintenance: Regular updates and bug fixes to ensure the app's performance and security.
  • Feature Upgrades: Adding new features and enhancements based on user feedback and market trends.
  • Performance Optimization: Enhancing the performance and responsiveness of applications.

Cloud Integration Services

  • Hybrid Cloud Integration: Seamlessly integrate on-premises infrastructure with public/private clouds.
  • Multi-Cloud Strategy: Implement a multi-cloud approach for improved flexibility and redundancy.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensure consistent data flow between cloud and on-premises systems.

  • Cost Optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving strategies for cloud infrastructure.

  • Security and Compliance: Ensure that cloud services meet regulatory compliance and data security standards.

item.title: Empowering Businesses with Custom Application Development: Kreatazz's Expertise
item.dc:creator: kreatazz.tech
item.content:encoded:
In today's digital era, businesses need to stay ahead of the curve by adopting innovative technologies and solutions. Custom application development plays a crucial role in addressing unique business challenges and driving growth. At Kreatazz, we specialize in creating bespoke applications that cater to the specific needs of our clients, ensuring they achieve their goals efficiently and effectively.

Experienced Leadership

At the heart of Kreatazz's success is our experienced leadership team. Our leaders bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise, allowing us to provide strategic consultation and guidance to our clients. We understand that each business is unique, and we take the time to understand the context, objectives, and challenges faced by our clients. This understanding forms the foundation of our custom application development process.

Customer Championship: Our Core Value

Our motto, "Customer Championship," reflects our commitment to putting our clients at the center of everything we do. We believe in building strong, lasting relationships with our clients by consistently delivering value and exceeding expectations. Our customer-centric approach ensures that we develop solutions that are not only innovative but also aligned with our clients' business goals.

Leveraging Modern Architectures

In the fast-paced world of technology, staying ahead requires adopting modern architectures and development practices. Our technology experts at Kreatazz are adept at utilizing cutting-edge architectures, such as microservices, serverless computing, and cloud-native development. These architectures enable us to build scalable, resilient, and future-proof applications that can adapt to the ever-evolving business landscape.

1. Discovery and Planning

The journey begins with a thorough discovery phase, where we collaborate closely with our clients to gather requirements and understand their vision. We create a detailed plan that outlines the scope, timeline, and milestones for the project. This plan serves as a roadmap for the development process, ensuring that we stay on track and deliver on our promises.

2. Design and Prototyping

Next, our design team works on creating intuitive and visually appealing prototypes that bring the client's vision to life. We prioritize user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) design to ensure that the final application is not only functional but also user-friendly.

3. Development and Integration

Our development team leverages modern technologies and best practices to build the custom application. We follow agile methodologies, allowing us to iterate quickly and incorporate feedback from our clients. Throughout the development process, we ensure seamless integration with existing systems and third-party services.

4. Testing and Quality Assurance

Quality is paramount at Kreatazz. Our dedicated QA team conducts rigorous testing to identify and resolve any issues before the application goes live. We perform functional, performance, and security testing to ensure that the application meets the highest standards.

5. Deployment and Support

Once the application is ready, we handle the deployment process, ensuring a smooth transition to the production environment. Our commitment doesn't end there – we provide ongoing support and maintenance to ensure the application continues to perform optimally and evolves with the client's needs.

In today’s fast-paced world, decision-making is more complex than ever before. With a constant influx of data, the challenge lies in transforming this data into actionable insights that drive informed decisions. That's where Kreatazz comes in.

Understanding the Challenge

Organizations across industries are grappling with vast amounts of data. However, having data is only the first step. The real power lies in analyzing and interpreting this data to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that can guide strategic decisions. Whether it's improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer experience, or identifying new market opportunities, the right analytical solution is key.

How Kreatazz Makes a Difference

At Kreatazz, we understand the importance of making data-driven decisions. Our comprehensive suite of analytical solutions is designed to help organizations harness the full potential of their data. Here’s how we can help:

1. Customized Analytical Solutions

No two businesses are the same, and neither are their analytical needs. At Kreatazz, we take the time to understand the unique context and requirements of each client. Our team of experts works closely with you to develop tailored analytical solutions that align with your specific goals and challenges.

2. Advanced Data Analytics

Our cutting-edge data analytics tools and techniques enable you to delve deep into your data. From descriptive analytics that provide a snapshot of your current performance to predictive analytics that forecast future trends, we equip you with the insights needed to stay ahead of the competition.

3. User-Friendly Dashboards

Complex data analysis doesn’t have to mean complex user interfaces. Our intuitive dashboards and visualizations make it easy for you to understand and interpret your data. With real-time insights at your fingertips, you can make quick, informed decisions with confidence.

4. Expertise Across Industries

Our experience spans a wide range of industries, including finance, healthcare, retail, and more. This diverse expertise allows us to bring industry-specific insights and best practices to the table, ensuring that you get the most relevant and impactful solutions.

5. Ongoing Support and Training

Implementing the right analytical solution is just the beginning. We provide ongoing support and training to ensure that your team is fully equipped to leverage the power of data analytics. Our commitment to your success means that we’re with you every step of the way.

item.title: Tailored Talent Solutions: How KITS Elevates Executive Search
item.dc:creator: kreatazz.tech
item.content:encoded:
At KITS, we invest in understanding the context of the client, the organization’s structure, the role to be filled, and its context. This understanding is captured in a document and forms the basis of the next few steps in the search process, followed by the premier staffing companies in India.

Based on the brief prepared earlier in the process, we create a plan to identify the possible matches. We review this plan with the client and co-create it. Then, we plan the communication with the potential candidates. We get into the next step, talent attraction, followed by talent assessment. We present our assessment of the short-listed candidates to the client and discuss further to draw up meeting schedules. With debriefs and reference checks happening simultaneously, we arrive at the selects. Offers are worked out in collaboration with the client. Throughout the process, we anchor the relationship with the candidates and help them set the ‘right expectations’ about the process, the role, the support systems, and the offer. With our 30-60-90 days’ touch-base plan, the whole process typically takes 8-12 weeks.

Our result-oriented process

  • Understanding the organization, the structure, the context of each role holder and the requirements.
  • Designing a plan for talent attraction, candidate assessment, and candidate communication.
  • Advertising the jobs on a variety of media.
  • Sourcing candidates through multiple channels: interest check and validate suitability.
  • Managing vendors and internal referrals, if any.
  • Receiving and screening applications sourced through all the channels – KITS internal database, external sources, and referrals.
  • Capturing details of the applicants in a format that is trackable over a period of time.
  • Coordinating interviews and any other steps in the selection process with shortlisted candidates.
  • Working with client teams for the issuance of offer letters to successful candidates.
  • Negotiating offers with the candidates.
  • Engaging offered candidates till their successful joining.
